name: makezaa-control
description: Control Makezaa’s posts, portfolio, media, customer inbox, agent tasks and completion reports through its authenticated MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Makezaa admin account to manage blog posts, projects, images and customer submissions. Give an agent a publishing task, track its progress, and receive a permanent Dashboard report plus a result in the current chat. News research and image creation use your agent’s own tools; scheduled runs use your agent’s scheduler.
defaultPrompt: Research today’s technology news, publish five original Makezaa posts with suitable images and source links, then report the results here and in the Dashboard.
Process the available Makezaa task queue and report each completed task.
Show Makezaa’s recent posts, projects and agent task reports.
